process COGAPS {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_high'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/b7/b766b163b9a8410332bc4691ea5d738ad2a718dda806e10cc332d5e10fee0a96/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/bioconductor-cogaps:3.33.0--9d268f422491d706'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(matrix)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.cogaps.rds")            , emit: rds
    tuple val(meta), path("*.feature_loadings.csv")  , emit: feature_loadings
    tuple val(meta), path("*.sample_factors.csv")    , emit: sample_factors
    path "versions.yml"                              , emit: versions, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    template 'cogaps.R'

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.cogaps.rds
    touch ${prefix}.feature_loadings.csv
    touch ${prefix}.sample_factors.csv

    cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml
    "${task.process}":
        cogaps: \$(Rscript -e 'cat(as.character(packageVersion("CoGAPS")))')
        r-base: \$(Rscript -e 'cat(as.character(getRversion()))')
    END_VERSIONS
    """
}

name: "nf-core/cogaps"
description: "Bayesian non-negative matrix factorisation of an expression matrix with\
  \ CoGAPS, identifying patterns (e.g. gene programs) and their activity across samples"
keywords:
- "nmf"
- "matrix factorisation"
- "gene programs"
- "patterns"
- "transcriptomics"
tools:
- cogaps:
    description: "Coordinated Gene Activity in Pattern Sets (CoGAPS) implements a\
      \ Bayesian MCMC matrix factorization algorithm, GAPS, and links it to gene set\
      \ statistic methods to infer biological process activity."
    homepage: "https://bioconductor.org/packages/CoGAPS"
    documentation: "https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/CoGAPS/inst/doc/CoGAPS.html"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/FertigLab/CoGAPS"
    doi: "10.1093/bioinformatics/btq503"

    - "BSD-3-Clause"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - matrix:
      type: "file"
      description: "Features x samples expression matrix with feature names in the\
        \ first column\nand sample names in the header (csv, tsv or txt, optionally\
        \ gzipped), or an\nrds file containing a dense matrix or data.frame. A SummarizedExperiment\
        \ or\nSingleCellExperiment is also accepted if it has a dense assay named\
        \ \"counts\".\nSparse matrices are not supported and must be converted before\
        \ the call.\nCoGAPS options, including the required nPatterns, are\npassed\
        \ via ext.args, e.g. '--nPatterns 7 --nIterations 50000 --seed 42'.\nOnly\
        \ scalar CogapsParams values can be set this way; non-scalar parameters\n\
        such as fixedPatterns, explicitSets, subsetIndices and geneNames are not supported.\n"
      pattern: "*.{csv,tsv,txt,csv.gz,tsv.gz,txt.gz,rds}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
